ios.desc:
3PO is a first-of-a-kind app that can auto-identify the language being spoken and translate to another spoken language in one step using LLM technology.

This one-touch speech-to-speech translator enables you to converse with almost anyone with little friction.

Language supported include:

Asia

- Chinese (Mandarin, Cantonese, SiChuan, Shandong), Bangla, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Cambodian*, Filipino*, Lao*, Mongolian*, Malay*, Burmese*, Nepali*, Sri Lankan*

Middle East & Africa

- Arabic, Persian*, Afghanistan*, Hebrew*, Kenyan*, Somali*, Tanzanian*, Zulu*

Europe

- Bulgarian, Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Irish, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Welsh

Albanian*, Armenian*, Bosnian*, Icelandic*, Georgian*, Kazakh*, Macedonian*, Maltese*, Serbian*, Uzbekistan*

(*) Language auto-identification not supported yet. Speech recognition and translation do work if you pick that language specifically on the bottom left.

Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

android.desc:
3PO is a first-of-a-kind app that can auto-identify the language being spoken and translate to another spoken language in one step continuously. No need to push a button after each sentence.

This one-touch speech-to-speech translator enables you to converse with almost anyone with little friction.

New: You can now practise speaking a foreign language with 3PO. It will then provide a score on the accuracy of your pronounciations.

Language supported include:

Asia

- Chinese (Mandarin, Cantonese, SiChuan, Shandong), Bangla, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Cambodian*, Filipino*, Lao*, Mongolian*, Malay*, Burmese*, Nepali*, Sri Lankan*

Middle East & Africa

- Arabic, Persian*, Afghanistan*, Hebrew*, Kenyan*, Somali*, Tanzanian*, Zulu*

Europe

- Bulgarian, Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Irish, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Welsh

Albanian*, Armenian*, Bosnian*, Icelandic*, Georgian*, Kazakh*, Macedonian*, Maltese*, Serbian*, Uzbekistan*

(*) Language auto-identification not supported yet. Speech recognition and translation do work if you pick that language specifically on the bottom left.
